# Pitch

> > Pitch is a collaborative presentation software platform that enables teams to create, share, and present with integrated scheduling and CRM tools.

Pitch Software GmbH, based in Berlin, Germany, and founded by Christian Reber, offers a modern presentation platform with deep integrations into productivity tools like HubSpot, Calendly, and Google Calendar. The platform emphasizes GDPR compliance and data protection for European users.

## Key Topics

- Pitch presentation software
- HubSpot Meetings integration
- HubSpot Forms integration
- Calendly scheduling
- Google Calendar sync
- Embed scheduling in presentations
- Meeting booking workflows
- Christian Reber (Founder)
- GDPR compliance
- Data protection (EU 2016/679)
- Pitch Software GmbH
- Berlin-based SaaS
- Collaborative presentations
- CRM integrations

## Integrations

- [HubSpot Meetings](https://pitch.com/integrations/hubspot-meetings): HubSpot Meetings integration for embedding booking pages in presentations
